name: Signal Generator
author: Vestra Player SDK examples
punchline: Test patterns, an oscilloscope and test tones generated by a plugin
description:
Generates its own video and audio and plays them in the player: colour bars, a moving grid or an oscilloscope of its own waveform, with a timecode overlay. The tone (sine, square, saw or noise) has live frequency, sweep, level, mute and balance controls.
SDK example: Player.openStream, a control window and an audio filter.
